paragraphs.text: Gadrak , the Crown-Scourge , is a dragon from an unknown plane.

Gadrak is a young dragon not yet 300 years of age. Due to this, he has yet to master the patience of his peers. He has embarked on a campaign of fiscal (and physical) carnage, looting every manor and castle in a 200-mile radius. Local lords have put a price on his head, but it’s a difficult prize to claim as he tends to shoot steel-melting flames.
